workflow_runs.name: fork release
workflow_runs.display_title: Fork: DeepSeek Harness sessions, OpenCode Go, fork releases

head_commit.message:
Fork: DeepSeek Harness sessions, OpenCode Go, fork releases

Agent:
- DeepSeek Harness sessions on the AI sessions widget, read through the harness's own
  local API (signed cookie from ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml), so the phone sees titles,
  models, token totals and who is waiting for an answer; the session files are a
  fallback that has to be opted into because the harness appends to them.
- OpenCode Go quota and spend read directly from opencode.ai with an API key that is
  now part of the settings page instead of a separate session file.
- Session titles from non-Claude tools are no longer stripped by the Claude title
  setting, since those titles are the only useful label on the phone.
- Second launches say why they exit instead of leaving a silent no-op.

Panel:
- DSH glyph and colours, and a DeepSeek Harness header in the session details sheet.

Releases:
- Default update source moved to this fork, version bumped to 0.9.24.
- .github/workflows/release-fork.yml builds the APK and the win-x64/linux-x64 agents
  and publishes them as a release with SHA256SUMS, which is what the updater reads.
